differences.a_observable: The camera is close to the JUSPAY card with a top-down angle, making it fill most of the frame.
differences.b_observable: The camera is further away and tilted at a steep oblique angle, showing more of the surrounding tiles.

differences.a_observable: The cards cast deep, soft contact shadows onto the white background tiles, creating depth.
differences.b_observable: The contact shadows are extremely faint and washed out, making the cards look flat.
differences.fix: Increase shadow density and adjust the light source to cast stronger contact shadows.

differences.a_observable: A distinct vignette is visible, darkening the corners of the frame.

differences.fix: Add a vignette effect to darken the corners of the frame.

differences.a_observable: The Recurly card has a warm, highly saturated golden-yellow color.
